mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate of at least 0.1% over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rises above 215.0, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5% and the Consumer Price Index exceeds 215.0, it signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it indicates a tight labor market, which typically precedes stronger economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production of at least 0.5% over the past 3 months signals strengthening economic activity, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1000.0 (thousands of units), it signals a strengthening housing market, which typically precedes broader economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise by at least 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals a robust housing market and strong consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth >= 0.5% AND HOUST growth >= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 380000.0 (millions of dollars), it signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 380000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
